name: Flintfire's Shipment
label: Quest
description: Flintfire's Shipment: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Hoha! Good to see a gnome who's not afraid to get their hands dirty.

If yer lookin' fer work, I'm afraid I'm a little short on supplies at the moment. Our most reliable source of ore has been overrun by wendigo and now the cave has been abandoned. The miners had to drop everything when they fled!
Say, why don't ye poke yer head around the Grizzled Den to the west and see if you can find some of our missing shipments. It would save us a great deal o' trouble.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Wendigos are nasty beasties. It's just good all the miners made it out of the Grizzled Den in one piece!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Now that's more like it! With these shipments we'll get the forge back up and runnin' in no time!

sources.title: Quest text one player sent in, not confirmed by a second yet
